title: Ansel and the Letter
author: Paloma Montrose
blurb: Paloma Fairweather, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
